map.FTND共6题，总分0-10，分数越高尼古丁依赖越严重: FTND has 6 items, total 0-10; higher scores mean more severe nicotine dependence
map.0-2分极低依赖，3-4分低依赖，5分中等依赖，6-7分高依赖，8-10分极高依: 0-2 very low, 3-4 low, 5 moderate, 6-7 high, 8-10 very high dependence
map.本工具供戒烟评估参考，建议到戒烟门诊获取专业戒烟支持: This tool is a cessation assessment reference; visit a cessation clinic for professional support
map.FTND 5 分→中度依赖，建议药物(伐尼克兰/贴剂)+行为支持。: FTND 5 -> moderate dependence; medication (varenicline / patch) plus behavioral support advised.
map.≥7 分重度，单靠意志力难戒，需强化药物与随访。: >=7 is severe; willpower alone rarely works, intensive medication and follow-up needed.
map.6 题 0–10 分，≤3 低、4–6 中、≥7 高依赖。: 6 items, 0-10 points; <=3 low, 4-6 moderate, >=7 high dependence.
map.依赖越高越需药物辅助与高频随访。: Higher dependence calls for medication support and frequent follow-up.
